about: Reference rounds for ping-core. Each beat gives the levels at the start of the beat, the in-beat order, one action per desk [kind 1 ping / 2 re-quote, level 1..24, algo flag], the events in resolution order [desk, 0 miss / 1 fill (pinger) / 2 picked off (victim), level, tenths] and resting/picked after the beat, in tenths of a lot.
